info.name: Oracle EBS Financial Services API
info.description:
RESTful APIs for Oracle E-Business Suite financial management modules including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, and Cash Management. These PL/SQL APIs are deployed as REST services through the Integrated SOA Gateway.

Contact Support:
 Name: Oracle Support
 Email: support@oracle.com
